messages:
clara: deploy-bot just throttled v3.9.0 to 30% for /embeddings, p95 +45% vs baseline. thinking: short stabilize window vs targeted rollback. who's on ops to call it?

deploy-bot: [automated] Throttle applied to rollout v3.9.0. Current traffic: 30%. Trigger: embeddings_p95_delta >= 40% over 5m. Suggested actions: wait 10m; route-split to stable; manual rollback to v3.8.7.

ops-oncall: i'm here. prefer split into 70/30 (stable fallback) first. if p95 > +30% after 12m -> run manual rollback. disable autorevert for now.

devops: i can apply 70/30 split for /embeddings in ~3m and stage the rollback command. prepping pin scripts for affected tenants.

sam: drafting internal blurb for customer comms: "We've noticed an embeddings latency regression and applied temporary traffic reduction while we investigate. We'll update if we rollback." will post if needed. :memo:

clara: plan: devops does 70/30 split; ops monitors and will call rollback at t+12m if no improvement. deploy-bot, suppress autorevert.

deploy-bot: [system] Autorevert suppressed by operator. Autorevert window paused until 4332163600.

devops: split applied: 70% -> v3.9.0, 30% -> v3.8.7. sanity checks: no spike in 5xx.

ops-oncall: t+6m update: p95 down to +28%. trending down. holding to t+12m per plan. if it doesn't drop below +20% by t+18m we execute: `/deploy rollback --service=embeddings --to=v3.8.7 --reason "perf regression v3.9.0"`

clara: if ops rolls back, we'll pin v3.8.7 for impacted customers and add a note to release notes + support FAQ. sam, have the blurb ready to publish.

sam: will publish on rollback. also looping legal for wording.

ops-oncall: standing by. reconvene at t+12m. :thumbsup:
